Did you know the Galil rifle has a built-in bottle opener? Developed by Israel after the Six-Day War and based on the AK-47, the Galil rifle packed hidden features soldiers actually used — including a wire cutter hidden in the bipod. This is one of the most clever pieces of military engineering history. Discover more hidden firearm features and military history stories at Simple History.
